EmailTemplate.subject: After Hours Emergency On-Call Preparation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You're on call next week for After-Hours Emergency calls. Thank you for your service!
You will cover from Monday at 12PM until the following Monday at 12PM, unless otherwise specified on the schedule.
Click here to see the full year schedule. ​​​​​
Not sure what to do, for any questions, please click below to review the Emergency On-Call Procedures document.
Click here to review procedures.
For After-Hours Emergency DC On-Call support, please refer to the DC After-Hours On-Call Contact list.
Please note that some sites have a dedicated DC ON-CALL CELL PHONE. Please call this number first before calling the DC Leaders directly. Please follow the designated after-hours contact list rather than reaching out to standard weekday contacts.
Click here for OPS roster.
In order to receive the $100 salary compensation for on-call service, you must fill out the On-Call PAF request (located in Paycom) during or upon completion of the weekly assignment. For more information, please visit the Emergency On Call page on the Intranet.
If the above resources do not provide the answer you are looking for, please contact your Sales Manager or Regional Manager for direction.
*This generated email was created by the RVPs. Please do not contact Meenakshi Kumar for On-Call related topics unless it is to update a confirmed and approved change on the schedule.*​
